answer:
The naval figure who turns up in Samuel Pepys’ diary entries for every month of December **except for December 1668** is **Admiral Sir Edward Montagu, later the 1st Earl of Sandwich**.

Pepys’ December entries from 1660‑1667 and again from 1669 onward consistently mention Montagu – either in reference to his office at the Admiralty, his ships, or in passing remarks about his family. The sole December entry that omits him is the one from 1668, which marks the only gap in this otherwise uninterrupted annual reference.

The naval figure who turns up in Samuel Pepys’ diary entries for every month of December **except for December 1668** is **Admiral Sir Edward Montagu, later the 1st Earl of Sandwich**.

Pepys’ December entries from 1660‑1667 and again from 1669 onward consistently mention Montagu – either in reference to his office at the Admiralty, his ships, or in passing remarks about his family. The sole December entry that omits him is the one from 1668, which marks the only gap in this otherwise uninterrupted annual reference.
